old_en: <<He>> smiles. "Good. I can't take your leash off just yet, not until you're trained." <<He>> ties <<his>> end of the leash around a wooden beam. "There should be enough slack for you to roam the entire cabin though."
old_kr: <<He>>【은는】 미소짓는다. "좋아. 아직 목줄을 풀어줄 순 없어, 네가 훈련될 때까지는." <<He>>【은는】 <<his>> 목줄 끝을 나무 기둥에 묶는다. "그래도 오두막 전체를 돌아다닐 만큼은 헐렁할 거야."
new_en: "Good," <<he>> says with a curt nod. Eden ties <<his>> end of the leash around a wooden beam.

old_en: "You don't mean that," <<he>> says. "This benefits you far more than me." <<He>> grabs you and bends you over <<his>> lap. "But I can't let you get away with being so insolent."
old_kr: "진심이 아닐 텐데." <<he>>【이가】 말한다. "이건 나보다 너한테 훨씬 더 이득이야." <<He>>【은는】 당신을 붙잡아 <<his>> 무릎 위에 엎드리게 한다. "하지만 네가 이렇게 무례하게 구는 걸 그냥 넘어갈 순 없지."
new_en: "You don't mean that," <<he>> says. "It's safer for you here. You'll learn." <<He>> grabs you and bends you over <<his>> lap. "But I can't let you get away with being so insolent."

old_en: "You ungrateful slut," <<he>> says. "Maybe I should throw you out and leave you to the wolves!" <<He>> winces and holds <<his>> side. "I need to get something for this."
old_kr: "이 은혜도 모르는 암캐 같으니," <<he>>【이가】 말한다. "널 밖으로 내쫓아서 늑대들한테나 던져줘야겠어!" <<He>>【은는】 얼굴을 찡그리며 <<his>> 옆구리를 붙잡는다. "이건 치료해야겠군."
new_en: "You ungrateful brat," <<he>> says. "Should've left you for the wolves." <<He>> winces and holds <<his>> side. "I need to get something for this."

old_en: Eden unties the leash from the wooden beam. "You've been a good <>, so I'm going to give you a bit more freedom. Don't you dare run out on me though. Stick to the cabin and the clearing just outside."
old_kr: 에덴이 나무 기둥에서 목줄을 푼다. "착한 <>【이었였】으니, 자유를 좀 주겠다. 하지만 내게서 도망칠 생각은 마라. 오두막과 바로 바깥 공터에만 있도록 해."
new_en: Eden unties the leash from the wooden beam. "You've been a good <>. Stick to the cabin and the clearing just outside."

old_en: Eden ties your leash to a wooden beam. "You've been a bad <>, so I'm going to make sure you don't go anywhere."
old_kr: 에덴이 당신의 목줄을 나무 기둥에 묶는다. "나쁜 <>【이었였】으니, 어디도 못 가게 해야겠군."
new_en: Eden ties your leash to a wooden beam. "You've been a bad <>. You'll have to learn to be good."

old_en: Eden isn't so bad, <> just lonely. It must be hard living here in the woods on your own.
old_kr: 에덴은 그렇게 나쁘지 않아, <>【은는】 그냥 외로운 거야. 혼자 숲에서 사는 건 힘들겠지.
new_en: It's lonely in the woods. Eden just wants company.

old_en: You are awoken a while later by Eden kissing you on the cheek. "Good morning." <<He>> yawns and stretches. "Time for breakfast."
old_kr: 얼마 후, 에덴이 뺨에 키스하는 바람에 잠에서 깬다. "좋은 아침." <<He>>【은는】 하품하며 기지개를 켠다. "아침 먹을 시간이야."
new_en: You are awoken a while later by Eden's weight shifting the bed. <<He>> yawns and stretches, then looks at you. "Come on. We need to start the day."

old_en: A while later you hear Eden stir. <<He>> rolls over and kisses you on the cheek. "Good morning." <<He>> yawns and stretches. "Time for breakfast." <<He>> notices your broken leash. "Oh dear, I thought these things were sturdier. You're such a good <<girl>> for not running off." <<He>> leans over and kisses you on the forehead, then looks thoughtfully at the broken remains of the leash.
old_kr: 얼마 후 에덴이 뒤척이는 소리가 들린다. <<He>>【은는】 몸을 돌려 당신의 뺨에 키스한다. "좋은 아침." <<He>>【은는】 하품하며 기지개를 켠다. "아침 먹을 시간이야." <<He>>【은는】 당신의 끊어진 목줄을 발견한다. "이런, 이것들이 더 튼튼한 줄 알았는데. 도망가지 않고 있다니, 정말 착한 <<girl>>【이】구나." <<He>>【은는】 몸을 숙여 당신의 이마에 키스하고는, 끊어진 목줄의 잔해를 생각에 잠겨 바라본다.
new_en: A while later you hear Eden stir. <<He>> yawns and stretches, then looks at you. "Come on. We need to start the day." <<He>> notices your broken leash. <<He>> grabs the remains, and looks at them for a moment. "Well. Seems like you're learning to be a good <<girl>>."

old_en: "I don't think keeping you tied is necessary any more. Just don't run off on me. Stick to the cabin and the clearing just outside, where it's safe."
old_kr: "이제 더는 널 묶어둘 필요가 없을 것 같군. 도망만 가지 마. 안전한 오두막과 바로 바깥 공터에만 있도록 해."
new_en: "I don't think keeping you tied is necessary any more. Stick to the cabin and the clearing just outside."

old_en: Eden isn't so bad, <> just lonely. It must be hard living here in the woods on your own.
old_kr: 에덴은 그렇게 나쁘지 않아, <>【은는】 그냥 외로울 뿐이야. 이 숲속에서 혼자 사는 건 힘든 일일 거야.
new_en: It's lonely in the woods. Eden just wants company.

old_en: You prepare the food and place it on the table in front of <<him>>. <<He>> takes a bite, then smiles and pats your head. <<He>> shares some with you and you eat together. Eden talks a lot about the minutiae of life here, pausing to allow you a response. You nod each time, which seems enough to satisfy <<him>>.
old_kr: 음식을 준비해 <<him>> 앞 테이블에 놓는다. <<He>>【은는】 한 입 먹더니, 미소 지으며 당신의 머리를 쓰다듬는다. <<He>>【은는】 음식을 조금 나눠주고, 당신도 함께 먹는다. 에덴은 이곳에서의 사소한 일상에 대해 한참 이야기하다가, 당신이 대답할 틈을 주듯 잠시 말을 멈춘다. 당신이 매번 고개를 끄덕이는 것만으로도 <<him>>【을를】 만족시키기엔 충분한 듯하다.
new_en: You eat the food alongside Eden. <<He>> doesn't start any conversations, and anything you start dies quickly. Eden allows you to have your fill before eating the rest, leaving the plate empty.

old_en: <<His>> plate empty, <<he>> stands and looks out the window.
old_kr: 접시가 비자, <<he>>【은는】 일어나 창밖을 본다.
new_en: <<He>> stands when <<he>> finishes, and looks out the window.

old_en: "It's a lovely day! We'll be able to get lots of work done."
old_kr: "날씨 좋군! 일 많이 할 수 있겠어."
new_en: "We have work to do."

old_en: "We've got lots of work to do today. A little rain won't stop us."
old_kr: "오늘 할 일이 많아. 비 좀 온다고 멈출 순 없지."
new_en: "Best start before the weather gets worse."

old_en: "The clouds are grumbling. Hope they don't burst before we're done for the day."
old_kr: "구름이 심상치 않군. 오늘 일이 끝나기 전에 터지지 않았으면 좋겠는데."
new_en: "The weather looks bad. Best start now."

old_en: "It's cold today. Best keep active."
old_kr: "오늘 춥군. 계속 움직이는 게 좋겠어."
new_en: "It's cold today. Keep warm."

old_en: You prepare the food and place it on the table in front of <<him>>. <<He>> takes a bite. "You did something to this, didn't you?" You try to suppress a defiant smile, but the twitching at the corner of your lips gives it away. <<He>> grabs you and bends you over <<his>> lap.
old_kr: 당신은 음식을 준비해 <<him>> 앞 테이블에 놓는다. <<He>>【은는】 한 입 먹는다. "이거에 무슨 짓 했지, 안 그래?" 반항적인 미소를 억누르려 하지만, 입꼬리가 씰룩여 들키고 만다. <<He>>【은는】 당신을 붙잡아 <<his>> 무릎 위에 엎드리게 한다.
new_en: You shove the plate away from you. The food spills over Eden and across the floor. <<He>> stands up, already annoyed. "I worked for that." <<He>> grabs you and bends you over <<his>> lap. "You'll learn what it's worth."

old_en: You snuggle up to Eden. <<He>> is taken aback, but <<his>> face soon softens and <<he>> wraps an arm around you.
old_kr: 에덴에게 바싹 파고든다. <<He>>【은는】 깜짝 놀라지만, 이내 <<his>> 얼굴이 부드러워지며 당신을 팔로 감싼다.
new_en: You snuggle up to Eden. <<He>> tenses for a moment, then places an arm around you. <<He>> pulls you uncomfortably tight to <<his>> body.

old_en: You remove your clothing and get in the bath. Using a sponge, you wash <<his>> back. <<He>> turns to you. "You're such a gentle thing. Now clean my chest." You continue washing, though it's more embarrassing when you can see <<his>> face.
old_kr: 당신은 옷을 벗고 욕조에 들어간다. 스펀지를 사용해 <<his>> 등을 씻겨준다. <<He>>【은는】 당신을 돌아본다. "정말 얌전하군. 이제 내 가슴을 닦아." 계속 씻겨주지만, <<his>> 얼굴이 보이자 더 당혹스럽다.
new_en: You remove your clothing and get in the bath. Using a sponge, you wash <<his>> back. <<He>> turns to you. "Clean my chest." You continue washing, though it's more embarrassing when you can see <<his>> face.
